items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: People like Lizzie Miles or, or Blue Lou weren't really blues singers, they were pop singers.

ctx.x: And, uh, the piano players mainly played classical music. Uh-huh. And, uh, the madams especially didn't care for, for, for, for, ragtime. Jazz, blues, ragtime. Sure. Yeah. And, uh, but blues never somehow filtered into the environment. I mean, they just didn't play the blues here. Uh, the city never produced any significant blues singers. Yeah. People like Lizzie Miles or, or Blue Lou weren't really blues singers, they were pop singers. Uh-huh. And Lizzie got famous for singing obscene lyrics. And, uh, the, uh,…
Well, why do you think that is, that we didn't produce any blues?
